details: For every finite binary class, $\mathrm{VC}_{\mathrm{extr}}(\mathcal H)\geq(\mathrm{VC}^{*}(\mathcal H)-1)/2$.
proof: The cited theorem gives $\mathrm{VC}^{*}(\mathcal E)\leq2\,\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal E)+1$ for every finite extremal class $\mathcal E$. Apply it to an extremal extension of $\mathcal H$ and use monotonicity of dual VC dimension under adding hypotheses; then minimize the extension VC dimension.
name: Extremal-Extension VC Dimension / Dual VC Dimension (affine)
